name: JavaScript
description: A small Node.js (CommonJS) inventory library with a dependency-free test runner; nothing is installed from npm. Five tasks: add a member, a coordinated two-place edit, a bug fix, a byte-exact BOM and CRLF edit, and tests that must kill mutants.

toolchain.name: node
toolchain.hint: Node.js 18 or later on the Admiral host's PATH

toolchain.name: git
toolchain.hint: git on the Admiral host's PATH

tasks.title: Add a member to an existing class
tasks.prompt: In src/item.js add a read-only getter `totalValue` to the Item class that returns unitPrice times quantity. Give it a JSDoc comment like the other members. Keep the existing tests passing (`node tests/run.js`).

tasks.title: Coordinated two-place edit: write a test function and register it
tasks.prompt: Add a test function `stockRemoveMoreThanAvailableThrows` to tests/stockTests.js and export it. It adds an item with 2 units and checks that removing 3 units throws InsufficientStockError (src/errors.js). A test only runs when it is registered, so also register it in tests/registry.js. `node tests/run.js` must pass.

tasks.title: Fix a bug from a failing test
tasks.prompt: The test priceCalculatorApplyDiscountTenPercent fails (`node tests/run.js`). Find and fix the bug in the library code. Do not change or remove the tests.

tasks.title: Edit a file with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings
tasks.prompt: In src/legacyCodes.js change MAX_CODE_LENGTH from 8 to 12. Change nothing else. The file is UTF-8 with a byte order mark and CRLF line endings; keep both exactly as they are.

tasks.title: Write tests for an untested function, including negative paths
tasks.prompt: truncate in src/textUtil.js has no tests. Write tests for it in a new file tests/textUtilTests.js and register each one in tests/registry.js. Cover the normal cases, the boundary where the value is exactly maxLength, and the negative paths (null value, maxLength below 3), checking the error type each one throws. Do not change src/. `node tests/run.js` must pass.

mutants.find: if (value === null || value === undefined) throw new TypeError('value is required');
throw new RangeError('maxLength must be at least 3');
mutants.replace: throw new TypeError('maxLength must be at least 3');
